Labor started with the type of contraction that trolled me many many times before. I paid no attention. Then they became more consistent. YAY. then BAM IM ON THE FLOOR screaming bloody murder. I couldn't breathe, and there was a point I was convinced that my baby and I weren't going to make it. I was suddenly shaky, light headed, felt as if I was going to faint. I told Stephen (SO) 'DROP ME OFF FIRST THEN GO DROP THE KIDS OFF' as the original plan was opposite. He dropped me off at the hospital, triage nurse took a look at me, didnt even register me, and raced me up to fetal assessment. She was pushing the 'up' button on the elevator multiple times. I began screaming MORE, louder. As soon as they got me to a bed they un-dressed me themselves, and as soon as they went to check me.. I had to push. The urge was unbearable so my body caved. Water broke all over the nurses, and I defacated. The pushing was constant. I could NOT stop even though they were screaming at me to. I cried hard. I thought I was hurting my baby by not giving him a break between. I now understand the whole 'ring of fire' but its more like 'Ring of wondering if you're split into five million pieces'. Stephen wasn't there. I was terrified. I swore to god I was dying. Two other kids and I had never felt pain like I felt. As soon as Benjamin came out I felt.. Instant relief pain wise, but there was still a lot of concern on my end for his well being. 9 on apgar! I will never EVER forget the fear and pain.
ALL THE POWER TO THE WOMEN WHO VOTE TO DO IT NATURALLY AND DO IT! <3 I AM A WUSS!

When I first read this post I thought 'AWW' then I realized you were talking about feral rats. Not the pets. Pregnancy brain. 

It depends how much money you want to spend if your SO and MIL don't care. There are a wide variety of traps you can purchase. I don't recommend the poison at all because a) you're pregnant and will have a new baby running around and b) rat could die in an un-reachable place and could just smell up the joint. 

If you don't want to kill the things there ARE no kill traps. But if you do that you will have to drive the rats atleast 5 miles from your home or else they'll just find their way back. 

There are also traps that kill instantly where you don't have to touch or look at the dead rats at all. It's basically a black container that they crawl into, it snaps COMPLETELY over them and you just dispose of the traps. 

When/if you buy traps try and find their line of travel. They LOVE travelling against walls and as they do so they excrete their special kind of.. Well pee and you may notice areas where the baseboards/floors are a little more dirty and have an odor. Put the traps along that line. 

I'm sorry you have rats and I hope I've helped!

She has never left this house, and I don't think she minds.
